item.title: Donalds selects Cuban American Ávila as Florida running mate
item.description: Florida GOP gubernatorial nominee Byron Donalds chose state Sen. Bryan Ávila as his running mate on Tuesday, adding a Cuban American military veteran to the ticket.

item.title: Trump administration considers demolishing Kennedy Center
item.description: The administration is exploring the possibility of razing the Kennedy Center and replacing it with an outdoor amphitheater, according to reports.
